problem_line: Field technicians lack real-time expert guidance, causing wrong diagnoses, wasted parts and repeat service visits.
product_line: FixSaathi: a working AI repair copilot that sees, listens and guides technicians safely, in their language.
pains: Most AC, appliance and solar technicians are trained informally. An unfamiliar model or fault means guesswork.
Wrong diagnosis leads to wrong parts and return trips: lost money for the service company, lost earnings for the technician.
Senior technicians are scarce. Remote video experts are costly and do not scale. YouTube is generic and in English.
Service reports are handwritten, incomplete or skipped, so real failure patterns by model and region are never captured.
affected: Field technicians (income and skills), service centres and home-services companies (cost per job, customer ratings), appliance / AC / solar brands (warranty cost, product quality data) and households (time and repeat downtime).
ground_truth: Only ~1 in 4 informal-sector AC technicians has AC training (CEEW). Field check: Jitendra, an AC and appliance technician in Mumbai, confirmed our Gemini diagnoses for fans and washing machines and added safety know-how a beginner would miss.
solution_line: FixSaathi turns the technician's phone into an expert standing right beside them.
flow: Technician opens the app and points the phone at the AC, fridge, fan or solar inverter.
Speaks the symptom in Hindi or English. The AI identifies the machine and asks short follow-ups.
Combines what it sees and hears to rank likely faults and highlight the suspect part.
Safety step first, then one step at a time by voice; each step checked on camera.
Fault, parts used and before/after photos sent to the service centre automatically.
outcomes: Fewer wrong diagnoses, fewer wasted parts and fewer repeat visits, so more jobs and higher earnings per day.
Voice-first in the technician's language, with a safety agent that blocks risky steps and escalates when unsure.
Each job enriches a shared fault knowledge base, turning new technicians into experts faster.
tools: Gemini API keys and model access; tuning the live FixSaathi voice prompt in Stream mode on a real fan; testing structured JSON outputs for diagnosis and service reports.

models: Built: streams the technician's camera (1 fps) and voice in real time, understands the machine and the spoken symptom, and talks back step by step in Hinglish, Kannada, Tamil or English. Calls our tools through function calling.
Low-latency, real-time camera + voice conversation is exactly what hands-on repair needs.
Built: diagnosis agent (ranks causes with a fault knowledge base), part locator (returns the part's box on the live frame) and report agent (structured JSON service report).
Strong multimodal reasoning with reliable structured output.
Built: turns any repair step into a visual picture card from the real camera frame, for steps that are hard to explain by voice.
Fast image generation grounded in the actual appliance photo.
Next: on-device safety checklist and job notes for low-network sites, synced later.
Small open model that runs on the phone, offline.

Enterprise plans: brand-specific repair guides, private fault knowledge base and fault analytics by model and region.
Freemium: limited free guided repairs per month, then a low monthly fee. Builds bottom-up adoption.
extra_rev: commission on genuine spare parts ordered in-app, and paid skill-certification courses for technicians.

Partner with home-services platforms and AC / appliance brands' authorised service networks.
More Indian languages, then Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines, Bangladesh, UAE and Saudi Arabia.
competitors: Not specific to the machine in front of them, not hands-free, mostly English.
Connects technician to a human expert over video.
Needs a paid human expert on every call; expensive and doesn't scale.

AI expert that sees the machine live and guides by voice in the technician's language.
Hands-free, vernacular, safety-first, auto-reports, and far cheaper than human experts.
moat: every guided repair adds verified fault-to-fix data by brand, model and region. This proprietary knowledge base makes guidance more accurate over time and is hard for a new entrant to copy.

stats: Room ACs sold in India in FY2025, a record year (ICRA). Every unit needs installation and years of servicing.
Growth in skilled room-AC technicians India needs: 0.37M in 2022-23 to ~2M by 2036-37 (CEEW).
Informal-sector AC technicians who have received AC training (CEEW).
Rooftop solar installations under PM Surya Ghar by Aug 2026, toward a 1-crore target (MNRE). A new installed base to maintain.
why_now: Real-time multimodal AI (Gemini Live) can now watch a live camera feed and talk back in Indian languages with low latency, making a live repair copilot practical for the first time.
India's installed base of ACs, appliances and rooftop solar is growing far faster than skilled technicians can be trained, so the gap widens every year.
Smartphones are already universal among technicians, so FixSaathi needs no new hardware: just an app on the phone they carry.

proof_learn: Gemini reads brands and specs, flags unmentioned risks and puts safety first. Jitendra, an AC and appliance technician in Mumbai, reviewed the results: he confirmed the fan, top-load and front-load (detergent overflow) diagnoses and added know-how Gemini missed, e.g. "10 mein se 7 baar motor kharab nahi hoti", and fridge cooling faults are often the defrost system, not gas. FixSaathi's fault knowledge base captures exactly this.
